svg.text: Z2 — converter on the substrate backside, inside the PCB opening
Z2 converts below the substrate, in the PCB opening, and sends 1 V vertically through the substrate TSVs
Section at y = 0 through the middle row of cells. Horizontal 30 px/mm; vertical scale ×3 (vertical exaggeration).
Layers thinner than 80 µm are drawn at a minimum height (as 80 µm thick); true thickness labelled. Z1 and Z2 share one z-mapping.
737 µm clear of the PCB backside; converter underside adiabatic in the model
BGA balls, peripheral only (48 V supply + return)
land-side attach RDL (48 V in, 1 V out)10 µm
microbumps / Cu pads + underfill (die side)10 µm
TIM (no lid in the model)50 µm
Cu TSV field under each cell — 1 V output (about 1 kA
total); 1444 vias (38 × 38), Ø30 µm at 60 µm pitch
48 V package RDL sheet — modelled as a 2-D
network sheet; not a separate FE layer
convective film on the TIM top, not meshed
